ownerDecision: docs/decisions/0001-owner-policy.md (The Shuttle becomes an Activity, D10; Shuttle Activity sounds chosen; The Shuttle as a story, 22 October 2026)
policy: Audio assets only: CC0 1.0 and CC BY 3.0/4.0. NC, ND, SA and unclear licences are excluded. Each bundled file is pinned with its SHA-256; CC BY sounds are credited on the Credits screen and in legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES, with any changes stated.
selection: The owner chose one option per cue in a private picker page on 21 October 2026, and the story's cues (with a new AMB-06 for the arrival concourse) in a second private picker on 22 October 2026; those sounds carry selectedAt. Licences were read from each sound's own page on the day it was chosen. SC-07 (the launch roll) was chosen in a second round the same day, after the owner turned down the first options.
status: Originals verified (see each file). Converted to Ogg Opus with MP3 fallbacks by scripts/build-shuttle-sounds.mjs; outputs and their hashes are listed per cue. Owner review is recorded under "review".

review.result: Approved on 21 October 2026: all 24 sounds of that selection, with no requested changes. AMB-06 (New laboratory) was then replaced by the owner's 22 October pick, which is approved with the story's sounds below.
review.method: Private audition page playing the committed outputs of build 618ef40 in both formats, with loops played between their markers and a seam check.
review.approvedOutputs: The output hashes listed per cue at 618ef40.

story.result: Approved: all 17 story sounds, with no requested changes.
story.method: Private audition page playing the outputs of the 22 October build in both formats, with loops played between their markers and a seam check.
story.approvedOutputs: The output hashes listed for these cues on 22 October 2026; the rebuild that produced them reproduced the 23 unchanged outputs approved on 21 October.

launchRoll.result: Approved: SC-07, with no requested changes.
launchRoll.method: Auditioned on the same private audition page (version 2, which added SC-07). The page did not save a verdict for it, so the owner approved it in chat: "SC-07 is approved. Install it (source-only update) in the test Discord."
launchRoll.approvedOutputs: The output hashes listed for SC-07 on 22 October 2026 (commit dff3dc5).

encoding.tool: FFmpeg LGPL-3.0-or-later build (legal/DEPENDENCIES.json buildTimeAudioEncoder; review in legal/ffmpeg-build-time-encoder.json), build time only on the development machine
encoding.fallback: MP3, served only to clients that cannot play Ogg Opus (Safari and iOS before 18.4)
encoding.status: Decided and the pinned build verified on 21 October 2026; no sound converted yet. Each converted file will be pinned with its SHA-256 next to its source.
